_about: What the approver's page shows for a Technical Publication / Presentation Document (G12). One file per form: change this file to change what the page shows - no code change. Read by IRSTasks through the `fields` key of the IRSTechnicalPublication entry in js/config/TaskFields.js (DOCUMENT_TYPES). The G12 route approves the Document itself (worklog 2026-10-22-10); the page reads it through our REST JAR, `GET resources/v1/irsproject/publications/{id}` (worklog 2026-10-22-12).
_generated: Written 2026-10-22 from the paper form R&D-PRJ-03-Rev.01 (documents/as-is-markdown/.../1.R&D/Forms/R&D-PRJ-03.md), labels word for word, rows in the paper's order. Every value verified on DOC-0002 with the JPO twin `exec program IRSPublicationDocumentContext`.

_source.project: the project the Document hangs under (`to[Reference Document].from`): name, title, EPMProjectNo
_source.task: the DOCUMENT's own values, under the keys PublicationDocumentService puts in `attributes`: title, publicationName, publicationType, venue, duration, submitCopyToLibrary
_source.derived: a list the service shaped: Author(s), from relationship IRSPublicationAuthor
_source.none: not a value: the Researcher / In-Charge / HOD / DH signatures live in the route, drawn by the approval panel below the form

_notShown: The top DATE has no value while the route is running; kept hidden, as on the STM form.
